newsitem.title: UK: Sharpe & Fisher sells 5.1 mln stg property.
newsitem.headline: Sharpe & Fisher sells 5.1 mln stg property.

text.p: British building supplies company Sharpe & Fisher said on Tuesday it had disposed of three properties for a total of 5.1 million stg.

"The associated profit, after costs, will be in the region of 1.2 million stg and will, subject to completion of these transactions, be included in the results for the year to December 31, 1996," the company said in a statement. The proceeds from these disposals would be applied to reduce the group's indebtedness, it added.

Sharpe & Fisher announced last April that it had purchased builders merchant Goodlands Ltd for 2.87 million stg. The acquisition raised its number of trading branches to 32 from nine. --London Newsroom +44-171-542 7717
